full_judgment: 3. Facts of the plaintiffs case, briefly, are these. One Abbas Miji was the owner of the suit plot No. 717 comprising an area of 2.07 acres. Abbas Miji at his death was survived by one son Abdul Khaleque Miji and some daughters. Abdul Khaleque Miji purchased the shares of his sisters and became the sole owner of the suit plot. The plaintiffs purchased the disputed. 0.19½ acres of land from Abdul Khaleque Miji by  means of our registered Kabalas of the years 1974 and 1976. Since their purchase they have been in exclusive possession of the said land. They erected structures and planted many trees. They had also mutated their names and obtained separate Khatian in respect of the said land. But the defendants having no right, title, interest and possession have been threatening the plaintiffs with dispossession from the suit land.
